topic.title: Wrap Against Edit
topic.shortdesc: User A only changes the nesting of existing content. User B only edits the text inside it.

body.p: Set auth.signing.key in the properties file before the first restart.
Use the authctl tool to validate the configuration.
The property auth.token.ttl controls how long an access token stays valid.
The Authentication Service validates user credentials and issues signed access tokens.
It runs as a stateless component and can be scaled horizontally behind a load balancer.

section.title: Configuring the service
section.p: The configuration file is read once, at startup.

note.p: A hot reload of the configuration file is not supported.

section.p: Restart the service after every change.
